We're growing quickly and recently raised our $1.5B Series F https://www.baseten.co/blog/announcing-our-series-f/, led by Altimeter Capital, Conviction Partners, and Spark Capital. Join us and help build the platform engineers turn to to ship AI products. This role is a great fit for entrepreneurial, customer-facing technical professionals who want a front-row view into how modern companies adopt AI at scale, and who enjoy working across technical discovery, solution design, demos, deployment scoping, and hands-on customer implementations, in close partnership with Sales and Engineering. REQUIREMENTS: - AI/ML background and the ability to credibly discuss AI/ML topics with technical stakeholders. - Strong customer-facing communication skills, including the ability to run structured discovery and clarify ambiguous requirements. - Technical depth to scope solutions, without needing to write production code. - Ability to script and prototype as needed, including comfort “vibe coding” to move quickly in technical workflows. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience running or supporting benchmarks for ML inference deployments. - Familiarity with infrastructure tradeoffs relevant to inference performance and cost (for example GPU selection and latency versus throughput tuning). - Experience serving as a cross-functional technical lead for customer POCs, including coordination across Sales and Engineering. At Beta Engineering, we believe in cultivating a team that wins together and takes on the most challenging projects in the high-voltage industry. We engineer, procure, and construct (EPC) projects for a variety of customers, including those in the utility, industrial, and renewable energy markets. Our work includes substations, transmission lines and more. We help our customers achieve their goals of creating a stronger power grid by reducing risks and identifying innovative solutions for their project challenges. Our Purpose: We pursue that which challenges us, growing our community to provide critical, creative solutions that achieve extraordinary results. Our Values: We do what we say, we turn challenges into success and we win together. Civil Engineer Team Leaders (CETL) are supervisors of multiple Civil Engineers and Civil Engineering Technicians overseeing the design of structures, foundations, overhead wires, aluminum bus, equipment design and site grading plans for electrical substations and transmission lines. The CETL is tasked with ensuring that their team’s designs, and applications, are completed to code and standards set forth by the appropriate authoritative bodies. In addition, CETLs are responsible for the training, recruiting, hiring, scheduling, assigning and discipline of CEs and CETs under their supervision. ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES: • The Civil Engineer Team Leader will have multiple employees reporting to this position. • Works with the VP of Civil Engineering to coordinate the scheduling of employee PTO. • Works with the VP of Civil Engineering to recruit, hire and train new engineers. • Provides input on organizational structure, employee performance, continuing education, employee development and disciplinary actions. • As assigned by the Civil Engineer Manager. EXPECTATIONS: • Performs quality work within deadlines without direct supervision. • Interacts professionally with other employees and customers. • Works effectively as a leader on all assigned projects. • Demonstrates integrity and ethics in all client relationships and communications. • Communicates regularly with supervisor and teams regarding designs, concerns, studies or tests. • Desires to participate in continued education and training. • Must have clean driving record as use of company vehicles is a requirement of position. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: • Bachelor degree (or higher) in Civil Engineering is required. • PE is required. • Strong background in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint required; strong verbal and written communication skills are required. WORKING CONDITIONS: • Will work in an office environment with minimal exposure to dust, noise, and other environmental hazards. May involve prolonged periods of sitting and frequent use of a computer, keyboard, and mouse. • Able to lift 50 pounds • Use of company vehicle, on occasion. A successful Motor Vehicle Report (MVR) is required. • Overnight travel is required to an active construction site for a period of one or two weeks at a time. Ability to perform duties safely and to adhere to each job site’s safety requirements; while working on an active job
